The MR-SPF6.5K-LP1-TL20E is a high-capacity 6.5kW hybrid solar inverter designed for homes, offices, and small businesses in Bangladesh. This advanced inverter delivers pure sine wave AC output, efficient MPPT solar charging, smart battery management, and hybrid operation using solar + battery + grid together.


Engineered to handle large household loads, this model supports up to 9000W solar input, 48V battery systems, dual AC output, and fast charging capabilities. Its reliable performance makes it ideal for areas with frequent load shedding, unstable grid voltage, and high energy demand.


Key Features


  • 6.5kW Pure Sine Wave Output - Delivers stable AC power for heavy home loads and sensitive electronics.
  • High Solar Input Capacity (Up to 9000W PV) - Supports large solar panel arrays for maximum daytime power generation.
  • Wide MPPT Voltage Range (60–450V DC) - Ensures efficient solar harvesting even in low-light or variable conditions.
  • 48V Battery System Compatibility - Works with both Lead-acid and Lithium batteries.
  • Hybrid Power Operation - Seamlessly combines Solar + Battery + Grid for uninterrupted power supply.
  • Fast Automatic Switching - UPS-grade transfer time of 10–20ms protects devices from sudden power interruptions.
  • Can Operate Without Battery - Ideal for users who want a solar-only daytime setup or plan to add batteries later.
  • Smart Monitoring Ready - Supports BMS communication (RS485 / CAN) and optional WiFi monitoring.
  • Compact & Lightweight Design - Saves installation space while offering powerful inverter performance.
